resolution.note: krn deliver aggregates Ticket, Change-contract and Co-Authored-By trailers from every PR commit

title: Deliver merge message aggregates trailers from all PR commits
body: krn deliver builds the merge message from trailers of the PR head commit only (src/deliver/message.ts:21, delivery.ts:263-265), so a PR whose last commit is the tracker close commit (Ticket only, no Change-contract) fails with exit 73 "head requires Change-contract trailers" even with --message-file (PR #143, #144). The repository workflow requires the task close as the last commit. Fix: aggregate Ticket and Change-contract trailers from every commit in base..head (one distinct Ticket, deduplicated contracts in first-seen order, Co-Authored-By deduplicated), and let --message-file be checked against the aggregated trailers. Acceptance: a PR with an implementation commit carrying contracts followed by a tracker close commit yields a merge message with the contracts; tests red at the base by assertion.
